user.title: Kaiyuan Gas Login
user.description:
Log in with the mobile number and password used in the WeChat H5 portal. The account number is detected automatically. {error}

The tiered gas prices below feed the ladder block on the card. The API does not return them; defaults are the Chongqing urban residential standard — adjust to your area.

locked.title: ⚠️ Account temporarily locked
locked.description:
**Server response:**

> {message}

Mobile number **{mobile}** was temporarily locked after too many wrong passwords. It normally clears after about **24 hours**. There is no way to lift the lock early, and every login attempt during the lock keeps failing without shortening the wait, so please do not retry repeatedly.

This is not a Home Assistant or integration failure — the connection itself works, the account is simply blocked from logging in.

Please retry with the correct password after the lock is lifted.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kaiyuan Gas
reconfigure.description:
Current account: **{mobile}**, current account number: **{cons_no}**.

Changes are verified by logging in before saving. Leave the password blank to keep it, and leave the account number blank to keep auto-detection.

To add another account, just add the Kaiyuan Gas integration again — one entry per account.

init.title: Reconfigure Kaiyuan Gas
init.description: Change the account, password, auto refresh interval or tiered prices. Account number: {cons_no}. Leave the fields blank to keep the current credentials; changes are verified before saving.
